pick.headline: Germany is reunited
pick.summary: At midnight on October 3, 1990, the German Democratic Republic acceded to the Federal Republic, and Germany was reunited.
pick.significance: Reunification inside NATO, accepted by Moscow, was the end of the postwar settlement in Europe. The Stasi's files and agent networks passed into the hands of the united state.
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of October 3, 1990, carried Sofia BTA in English: President Zhelev cabled Weizsacker wishing united Germany "a wonderful future", calling unification a triumph of freedom over ideological tyranny.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 192, 3 October 1990
evidence.snippet: …any a won- derful future Up to now the two German states symbolized the division of Europe and the Berlin Wall was an absurd synthesis cast out of concrete, fear and suffering, the cable reads. It is emphasized that the unification of the country is a triumph of freedom, democracy and peace in Europe and the world, a triumph over ideological tyranny, over military confrontation and over hostility and suspicion between East and West.
